what: vendored, pinned copy of the FP32 PyTorch reference implementation of Kolibri-1; used only by tools/make_kolibri1_ref.py to write kolibri1_tiny/ref.json
source: written for this engine from the checkpoint's published semantics and the vendor plugin (see the file's docstring and docs/kolibri1.md)
